mentions.name: hyperbin
mentions.description: A fast, minimal httpbin clone written in Rust, offering roughly 20x the throughput of the usual httpbin for testing HTTP clients and debugging requests without extra noise.
mentions.problem: The usual httpbin is slower when testing HTTP clients and debugging requests.
